# Orchard grafting schedule

Grafting moves from late March to the second half of February. The rootstock is dormant in February and the scions cut in January keep better than the March cuttings did; last year's March grafts took at under half the rate of the February trial row.

The grafting tape changes to the biodegradable kind, so nobody has to walk the rows in May cutting it off.
